_comment: Core base merged into ~/.claude/settings.json by bin/link-harness (union), together with packs/*/permissions.json. Manual install: permissions + hooks, __ROOT__ = this repo. Plugin mode: only permissions (hooks/hooks.json registers the guards). Platform deny/ask rules live in the packs; here only the core ones: deny = editing the security profile and the read-only mode file (only the user changes them; ro-guard covers Bash), ask = git force push and hard reset (confirm and show the exact command).
